svg.aria-label: th3-skills: Claude Code skills, each doing a whole job. poc-spec-driven-builder: proves an idea, tests first. In: “Can tickets sync to a sheet?”. Out: spec, test matrix, build, a PR with the proof. design: screens, flows, banners, scored. In: a live page, a brief, an author's own 9.8. Out: a Figma screen and its flow, a banner; critic-scored 9.4. marketing: prices, listings and posts. In: a salary, monthly costs, a marketplace category. Out: 4 packages, none at a loss, a listing, a post to sell it. agent-kit: cheaper agent runs. In: every agent on the top tier, briefs that differ. Out: the cheapest tier that works, one cached prefix. thai-mock-naming: mock names that are fake on sight. In: a test user who looks like a real person. Out: a marker name: fake on sight, one grep finds every row. dependency-vuln-explainer: does this CVE reach you?. In: a Dependabot alert, CVSS 10.0. Out: traced through the lockfile: not reachable, priority low. qa: QA evidence and reports. In: a Q&A sheet, export buttons, an Excel import, a ticket. Out: remarks, an evidence .xlsx, a test run, a Jira report. devops: infra changes with a report. In: a change on a real server. Out: plan, approved steps, checks, before / after / rollback. software-engineer: release docs for PM, BA, QA. In: a release scope, retests, before and after shots. Out: a release PDF: changes, shots, BA questions, a test plan. documentation: docs in one house style. In: a Markdown file, two annex PDFs. Out: one PDF + DOCX in the house theme, annexes merged. game-dev: idea to playable game. In: “an obby where the floor follows the music”. Out: a brief, a Roblox place, a playtest the agent ran. containers: wins back Podman disk. In: a disk full of old images. Out: pruned, trimmed, the WSL disk compacted: space back.
